description: Curated starter questions that pop the user's Claude Code Desktop with a context-rich prompt. The dashboard's ASK tab is a launcher — the conversation happens in the user's own Claude Code session, sourced from the bus content they already have synced via OneDrive.

questions.label: Cold-open framings that work
questions.hint: Hobbs's verbatim openings + when each fits
questions.question: What cold-open framings does Hobbs use that actually land? Give me his verbatim openings with the situations each fits.

questions.label: "I'm just a grazier" objection
questions.question: A prospect says "I wouldn't say I do anything out of this world" — how does Hobbs handle that self-deprecation without flattery?

questions.label: Ben's curiosity-frame cold open
questions.question: Tell me about Ben's curiosity-frame cold-open pattern. Why is it working and how should I deploy it?

questions.label: "25% is too high"
questions.question: A landholder is pushing back on the 25% AgriProve share. How does the team handle this objection?

questions.label: "25 years is too long"
questions.question: A landholder is worried about being locked in for 25 years. What's Hobbs's reframe + what does the AgriProve guide add?

questions.label: Additionality objection
questions.hint: "I'm already doing this — why pay AgriProve?"
questions.question: A landholder argues they're already doing regenerative practices and don't need the methodology — why should they sign up? Walk me through Hobbs's framing.

questions.label: On-farm sequence
questions.question: What does Hobbs do in the first 30-60 minutes on-farm? Give me his sequence so I can prepare for tomorrow's visit.

questions.label: Pre-visit checklist (Riverina grazier)
questions.hint: What to bring, ask, prep before walking on-farm
questions.question: I have a farm visit tomorrow with a Riverina grazier (~1500 ha). What should I prep, what should I bring, and what are the 3 most important questions to ask?

questions.label: Re-engage after KCT silence
questions.question: A landholder went silent after KCT was issued. What does Hobbs do to break the pattern without sending another generic check-in?

questions.label: Nurture-back from a "no for now"
questions.question: What's Ben's nurture-back tactic for landholders who said no 6 months ago? Walk me through the framing he uses.

questions.label: What worked in the last 6 visits
questions.question: Across the 6 most recent farm visits, what patterns emerged? Which framings landed and which didn't?

questions.label: Best times of day for calls
questions.question: What does our data say about the best time of day to make outbound calls — both for connect rate and for booking farm visits? Walk me through Kieren's recent analysis and what it implies for how I should structure my call blocks this week.

questions.label: Pre-system conversion baseline
questions.hint: Win rate + days-to-close before this system
questions.question: What's our historical pre-system baseline for deal conversion — win rate, days to close, by year? Is the trend improving or worsening, and what does that imply for what we should focus on?

questions.label: LawrieCo channel performance
questions.question: LawrieCo deals close ~3x faster than direct — what's the captured pattern, and what should we replicate in non-LawrieCo deals?

questions.label: Full Hobbs objection playbook
questions.hint: Seven framings he uses on farm
questions.question: Give me Hobbs's full objection-handling playbook — the seven topic framings he's used on actual farm visits, with the verbatim language for each.

questions.label: What should I work on today?
questions.hint: Read your work-cards queue + deal signals
questions.question: Look at my work-cards queue and the active deal signals — what should I work on today, in priority order? Cite specific deals and the heuristic each pull was made from.
